card.name: First digit of a number after a comma
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number that comes right after a comma in a list of numbers, such as years, counts or percentages. It often sits at the start of a 3- or 4-digit figure.

modes.label: Years in a list
modes.description: The first digit of a year after a comma in a list of dates.

modes.label: Counts or percentages in a series
modes.description: The first digit of a count or percentage following a comma in a run of figures.
